metadata.title: Generative Artificial Intelligence Adoption Rate Overall: Working-Age Adults
metadata.notes: This series reports the share of adults aged 18-64 who use generative artificial intelligence for any purpose, whether for work, personal use, or both. Employed respondents are asked: "Do you use Generative AI for your job?" and "Do you use Generative AI outside your job?" Non-employed respondents are asked: "Do you use Generative AI?" Respondents answering yes to either question are counted as users. Data come from the Real-Time Population Survey (RPS), a nationally representative online labor market survey of working-age adults aged 18-64 in the United States. When using this work, please cite: The Rapid Adoption of Generative AI, A. Bick, A. Blandin, and D. Deming, Management Science (2026) (https://pubsonline.informs.org/doi/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02523). See https://www.genaiadoptiontracker.com/ for more information.

metadata.title: Generative Artificial Intelligence Use Last Week Overall: Working-Age Adults
metadata.notes: This series reports the share of adults aged 18-64 who used generative artificial intelligence for any purpose last week. Respondents who report using generative artificial intelligence are asked, separately for work and outside of work: "Did you use Generative AI [for your job/outside your job] LAST WEEK?" It covers all adults aged 18-64, counting as users last week only those who used it on at least one day in either setting. This series is by construction no higher than the corresponding adoption rate, because some respondents who use generative artificial intelligence did not use it last week. Data come from the Real-Time Population Survey (RPS), a nationally representative online labor market survey of working-age adults aged 18-64 in the United States. When using this work, please cite: The Rapid Adoption of Generative AI, A. Bick, A. Blandin, and D. Deming, Management Science (2026) (https://pubsonline.informs.org/doi/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02523).
